name: The Heart of Yiwha: Of Love & Vengeance
original_name: ยิหวาดาตัง
overview: Yiam gives up his dream of becoming a doctor to pursue dark magic and seek revenge. Along the way, he meets Yiwha, a woman bound by a prophecy to bring tragedy to her family, and together they navigate a dangerous world shaped by fate, magic, and vengeance.
